violations.text: Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the kitchen 2-door reach-in cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The ice machine was taken out of service during the time of inspection and ice was voluntarily disposed of. Establishment is not to return unit to service until equipment is cleaned, sanitized, and allowed to air dry. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The deli area hand sink was observed lacking the installed splash guard next to the deli slicer. Per interview of PIC, the previously installed splash guard had been broken and is to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the kitchen 2-door reach-in cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the deli air circulating fan and walk-in coolers fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The doors to the toilet rooms by the produce food preparation space and retail produce space are not self-closing. Toilet room doors that open to food preparation spaces shall be self-closing to prevent potential contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

The hand-washing sink in the deli was blocked by blender pitcher in the sink basin. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Equipment was moved during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The ice machine was taken out of service during the time of inspection and ice was voluntarily disposed of. Establishment is not to return unit to service until equipment is cleaned, sanitized, and allowed to air dry. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Rotisserie chicken was observed held at 122 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items had been cooked less than 2 hours prior to the time of inspection and upon interview of PIC, the oven was not turned on to warm after cooking. Food items were reheated at the time of inspection, and the oven was turned on to keep items warm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The presence of birds is not controlled as evidenced by activity in retail spaces and entry vestibule. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to work with pest control to create a plan to exclude birds and other flying pests that may enter the retail and storage spaces. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The deli area hand sink was observed lacking the installed splash guard next to the deli slicer. Per interview of PIC, the previously installed splash guard had been broken and is to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

Birds were observed flying in the retail space. Per observation of the hot food holding table/bar, it does not have overhead protection from contamination. Establishment is to cover RTE food items until permanent overhead protection is installed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the kitchen 2-door reach-in cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026

The rotary cheese grater/shredder located in the back kitchen area was observed being held together with duct tape and was not in good repair. Equipment was taken out of service during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the deli air circulating fan and walk-in coolers fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The doors to the toilet rooms by the produce food preparation space and retail produce space are not self-closing. Toilet room doors that open to food preparation spaces shall be self-closing to prevent potential contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2026
The floor tiles and wall in the back kitchen area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Food items were placed hot into the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Food items were transferred imediatley onto shallow pans one layer deep. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2023
The hand sink in the deli is lacking a splash guard, a splash guard must be placed to prevent splashing between the handsink and prep table. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023
The non-food contact surfaces of the produce case have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023
The condensate from the produce refrigeration unit is draining onto the floor Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2023
The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2023

The floor in the kitchen area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. The ceiling tiles above the sales floor and in the produce prep area are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/14/2023
